avis.titre: If You Have Bags, You NEED to Know!!
avis.texte: This eye "treatment" has a nice, lightly creamy texture that feels great going on. It provides a *very mild* smoothing and hydrating effect to the undereye area. However, as other reviews have mentioned, it pills terribly under makeup. That aside, if you're dealing with under-eye bags, I'm sorry to say there's a reason this won't help you. If your puffiness is caused by allergies, watery eyes, fluid retention, lymph buildup, fatigue, or a salty diet, addressing those underlying issues can make a noticeable difference—and this cream might offer a *tiny* bit of additional improvement. But if you're like most people over 40 and your bags seemed to appear suddenly and never went away—or gradually worsened—you're likely dealing with herniated fat pads. This happens as we age: the membrane that holds the orbital fat around the eye weakens, allowing it to bulge and create that "bag" appearance. It's a normal, frustrating part of aging, and NO cream will eliminate it, no matter what cosmetic companies promise! The only effective treatment for this type of under-eye bag is surgery. Period. (You can easily find more information on this with a quick online search.) In conclusion, if you're just looking for a little moisture and a *very* slight temporary smoothing effect from mild puffiness—and you don't plan to wear makeup over it—this cream may help. Otherwise, save your hard-earned money and consult an oculoplastic surgeon for a fast, permanent solution to rejuvenate the eye area. Goo
